title: ledger.corp.internal is healthy, but this host can't reach it by name

instructions.mission:
The `ledger.corp.internal` service is reported healthy, but requests from this host fail when you use its name.

Your job:
1. Determine whether the failure is in the web service, DNS, or this host's name-resolution path.
2. Fix this host so `ledger.corp.internal` resolves through DNS again and the service's HTTP health endpoint can be reached by name.

Do not work around the problem by pinning an address locally; restore normal DNS-based resolution.

hints: Split the problem into layers: confirm the HTTP service is listening, then test whether the name resolves on this host, then test whether DNS queries through the configured resolver get an answer.
Use tools like `ss -ltnp`, `getent ahosts ledger.corp.internal`, and `dig ledger.corp.internal` to compare direct service reachability with name resolution.
The zone data is fine; the problem is in this host's stub resolver configuration. Inspect the nameserver entries in `/etc/resolv.conf`.
